The Agency has developed bilateral assistance and is supporting the countries in a number of domains. Israel has requested support to the EUMedRail project to learn from an EU country with experience building tunnels and developing special regulation. The EUMedRail project has organised a technical visit with the Italian IM RFI the Italian NSA ANSFISA and Italferr to exchange experiences. Besides the EUMedRail project has supported Israel to learn from the experience of the Austrian and Swiss with ERTMS. A safety certification scheme has been introduced in Israel including an independent assessment of Israel Railways followed by a certification delivered by the Ministry acting as the national safety authority. The Agency has helped Egypt build safety indicators to assess safety performance in their railway network and has developed a database which follows the structure and methodology of ERAIL Railway accident and incident investigations.SMS has been introduced in the railway legislation in AlgeriaAlgeria Egypt Israel and Morocco apply the EU methodology to draft their annual reports. All the countries with operational railways are implementing ERTMS projects

title.narrative: Increase of transport volume (passenger and freight) on rail.

description.narrative: Increase of transport volume (passenger and freight) on rail.

comment.narrative: There is no data about the volume of passengerfreight transported by rail

The railway transport has undergone massive investments in the EUMedRail countries. In Morocco more than 1100 km of high speed railway line will be constructed by 2040As part of the Rail Strategy 2040 Israel is making massive investments to extend and upgrade the network. One of the reasons is the huge growth in the demand of passengers 23 Million per year. Currently the network is 1600km long the maximum speed that trains can run is 160 kmh ISR has 60 stations 150 Complete passengers train unit and 70 million passengers annually. By 2040 Israel will have extended the network to 2500 km have ERTMS CCS system ETCS L2 installed trains will run at a high speed of 250 Kmh the number of stations will increase to 120 and the passengers per year will rise to 306 million. Egypt is developing the highspeed across the country. The DB is going to manage and operate the highspeed electric railway network in Egypt for a period of 15 years which can be renewed for another 15 years. A railway programme could see the construction of more than 2000km of lines over the next 2 years with the aim of totalling 12 500km by 2030 compared to 4300 km in 2020.

One of the reasons is the huge growth in the demand of passengers 23 Million per year. Currently the network is 1600km long the maximum speed that trains can run is 160 kmh ISR has 60 stations 150 Complete passengers train unit and 70 million passengers annually. By 2040 Israel will have extended the network to 2500 km have ERTMS CCS system ETCS L2 installed trains will run at a high speed of 250 Kmh the number of stations will increase to 120 and the passengers per year will rise to 306 million. Egypt is developing the highspeed across the country. The DB is going to manage and operate the highspeed electric railway network in Egypt for a period of 15 years which can be renewed for another 15 years. A railway programme could see the construction of more than 2000km of lines over the next 2 years with the aim of totalling 12 500km by 2030 compared to 4300 km in 2020.

description.narrative: Tunisia has started to draft a project of law to set up a NIBFollowing some internal reforms in 2021 in Algeria, the Ministry of Public Works and Transport has created a new directorate responsible for safety regulation and supervision, some of the key tasks of the NSAs. General progress has been made in all the countries with operational railways to reinforce the responsibilities of the NSA/NIB integrated in the Ministries of TransportAlgeria, Egypt, Israel and Morocco apply the EU methodology to draft their annual reports. Egypt is developing a database, which follows the structure and methodology of ERAIL Railway accident and incident investigations.A safety certification scheme has been introduced in Israel, including an independent assessment of Israel Railways, followed by a certification delivered by the Ministry, acting as the national safety authoritysecurity and protection that the migrants are rightfully entitled to following good governance principles.
